name: VALLEY PRESS
introduce: Extend your arms in front of your upper abdomen. Hold a dumbbell in each hand with your palms toward the ceiling. \n\nBend your elbows and bring the dumbbells close to your upper abdomen, then extend them. Repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Please prepare two dumbbells that you feel comfortable with.
You can feel your chest burning.
Exhale when stretching your arms, and inhale when bending them.
Squeeze your chest when stretching your arms.
